turns.q: If it doesn't work out for me, what are my options?
turns.replyText:
If it doesn’t work out, you can return eligible items for store credit.

- Items must be unworn, unused, in original/new condition with tags attached, and returned within 30 days of delivery.
- Start the return in the [Fashion Nova Returns Portal](https://returns.fashionnova.com/fashionnova/returns).
- Refunds are issued as a Fashion Nova e-gift card (store credit) in USD once the return is processed at the warehouse.
